data.name: Obaid
data.gender_notes: Obaid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who serves, the helper, the supporter. The name Obaid carries the meaning “Servant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Obaid usually hope their child will grow to embody servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of great responsibility and honor. The one who carries the burden of serving and supporting others, often in a leadership role.
data.etymology: Obaid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obaid total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عُبَيْد
in_arabic.meaning: عبد اللہ کا خادم، اللہ کا طِفل
in_arabic.long_meaning: عُبَيْد اللہ کے خادم یا اللہ کے طفل ہونے کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، جو عبادت اور توحید کی علامت ہے۔ اس نام کی اصليت عربي ہے اور قرآن میں اس جیسے الفاظ موجود ہیں جو عبادت اور خادمیت پر دلالت کرتے ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: عبید
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبید نام کا مطلب ہے اللہ کا بندہ یا خادم۔ یہ نام عربی मूल کا ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ عبادت اور توحید کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال مسلم معاشروں میں خاص کر عبادت و رسالت کے مفاہیم کے ساتھ جڑا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उबैद
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान का सेवक, प्रभु का दास
in_hindi.long_meaning: उबैद नाम का अर्थ है भगवान का सेवक या प्रभु का दास। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह सेवा और एकेश्वरवाद की ओर संकेत करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का प्रयोग धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के साथ किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عبيد
in_pashto.long_meaning: عبيد نوم د الله د بنده يا الهي خادم په مانا دی. دا نوم عربي ريښه لري او د اسلامي دوديزۍ په منځ کې ډير اهميت لري، ځکه چې دا د عبادت او توحيد په لور اشاره کوي. په افغان او پښتون دوديزۍ کې دے نوم استعمال د الهي عبادت او رسالت د مفاهيمو سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Obaid
in_english.meaning: Servant of God, Worshipper of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Obaid is derived from the Arabic root 'a-b-d' which means 'servant' or 'worshipper'. It signifies a person who is devoted to the service of God. In Islamic tradition, the name Obaid reflects a deep sense of spirituality and submission to Allah. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a close bond with the divine.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: اوبَید
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عبيد

data.cultural_impact: The name Obaid holds an important place in Islamic history. It is a name linked to great leaders and scholars who have contributed significantly to the community. For instance, Caliph Umar ibn Obaid Allah, who ruled the Islamic State between 634 and 644 AD, played a crucial role in spreading Islam through conquests and expanding the administration of the Obaid Rasheed, a renowned Sufi scholar and mystic, contributed significantly to spreading Sufi teachings in the Indian Subcontinent. The name also resonates with the values of serving and helping others, which is deeply embedded in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, the concept of serving and being of help to others holds a special spiritual significance. It is one of the fundamental principles of Islam that requires adherents to serve and help others, be it their fellow Muslims, humanity at large, or even the environment around them. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "It is not for you to be pleasantly-scented shepherds leaving the flock on the edge of a precipice." (Sunan Ibn Majah, 3725). The name Obaid signifies a commitment and dedication towards serving others, helpfulness, and the spirit of selflessness. It inspires those who bear the name to serve and support those around them, not only in their personal lives but also in the wider community. It is a constant reminder of the spiritual journey towards achieving closeness to Allah (God) by serving His creations.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant" symbolizes The one who serves, the helper, the supporter. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Obaid serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Obaid was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Obaid carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Obaid was one of the earliest converts to Islam.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Obaid remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Maryam Obaid, a teacher in Cairo, Egypt, shares that their name Obaid meaning "Servant" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
